role description: Designed and developed a large-scale Enterprise Event Hub (EEH) platform enabling self service Kafka topic creation and secure streaming access management. Built high-performance REST APIs using Django for event onboarding, access provisioning, and audit tracking, including a low latency Kafka publishing API with HMAC based authentication that achieved a 300 percent latency reduction over Kafka REST Proxy. Developed fault tolerant Kafka producers and consumers with retry logic and Dead Letter Queue (DLQ) handling, maintaining greater than 99 percent delivery success. Managed multi cloud Kafka deployments across AWS, Azure, and GCP, and implemented centralized error handling and structured logging for improved observability.
